texts.preamble: S. Hanumanthu vs The State Of Telangana, And 2 Others on 16 February, 2022 Author: P.Naveen Rao Bench: P Naveen Rao, G.Radha Rani Hon'Ble Sri Justice P.Naveen Rao And Hon'Ble Smt Dr.JUSTICE G.Radha Rani Writ Petition No.29182 of 2021 Date:16.02.2022 Between: S. Hanumanthu S/o.Balu, Aged 38 yrs, Occu :Mason, R/o.H.No.4-35/1, Eerla Tanda, Almaipalle Po Ghanpur, Mahabubnagar, District, Telangana State .....Petitioner And The State of Telangana, Rep., by its Principal Secretary, General Administration (Spl.(Law & Order) Department, Secretariat, Hyderabad & others. .....Respondents
texts.facts: 2. This writ petition is instituted by the cousin of detenu Sabavath Ganesh, challenging the order of detention dated 27.05.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime offenders and While Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986). 3. Heard Sri P.Trivikram Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for home. 4. The order of detention is made on the ground of involvement in five crimes by the detenu. These five crimes are registered under Section 356, 379, 354, 382 and 323 of Indian Penal Code. In Cr.No.111 of 2020, it is alleged that the detenu snatched away nuptial thread from the neck of the wife of complainant. In Cr.No.128 of 2020, it was alleged that the detenue snatched away gold nuptial thread weighing two tulas infront of the house of complainant. In Cr.Nos.118, 132 & 146 of 2020 also similar allegations were made. 5. It is not in dispute that in all these crimes, the competent Court has granted bail.
